title: The Kindly Smile
author: Orsen Yarrow
blurb: Noor Zhou, the new teacher at a school with a missing-class problem, doesn't believe, has never believed, will not begin believing now. But when the excavation crew unearths a door, sealed from the inside, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must finish the ritual the founders started before the well refills.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
